title: Exact rationalizations of compatible normalized lattice sequences
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a pointed connected qcqs topologically Noetherian scheme $(T,p)$. Use [def-sfb-monodromy-realization-data]. Fix a finite correspondence $c$, a functor $J$ from continuous $E$-representations to rational module sheaves, equivariant maps $f:V\to W$ and $g:W\to Z$, and invariant finite free spanning lattices $C,B,D$ with $f(C)\subset B$ and $g(B)\subset D$. Give these lattices normalizations $N,M,P$ for $c,J$ and the two maps normalization maps $F,G$. Suppose for every positive uniformizer power the maps induced on $C/\varpi^{n+1}C$, $B/\varpi^{n+1}B$, $D/\varpi^{n+1}D$ are injective, exact in the middle, and surjective, with their formulas specified on every lattice residue. Then the actual integral maps $F_{\mathrm{int}}$ and $G_{\mathrm{int}}$, after extension along the integral-to-field coefficient inclusion, form a short exact sequence of rational module sheaves. No global normalization choices, additivity, or full faithfulness of $J$ is assumed.

source.place: Definition 6.8.3, Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4),(6), pp. 59–60, and the integral-monodromy reduction in the proof of Corollary 6.8.5, p. 60. The exact-realization formulation makes the comparison used in that proof explicit; it does not assert closure of all pro-étale lisse sheaves.

proof.text: Identify the actual sheaf maps on the chosen geometric fibre with the supplied quotient maps by their formulas on every lattice residue. The finite Galois correspondence makes the set-valued fibre functor faithful on finite locally constant sheaves; thus the composites vanish. Restrict scalars to the lifted integer ring. The abelian-group forgetful equivalence and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-local-abelian-forget] identify these sheaves as finite locally constant modules over this Noetherian ring. Their homology is finite locally constant. Its zero stalk locus is clopen; connectedness and vanishing at the given fibre force it to be the whole scheme. Therefore exactness, monomorphisms and epimorphisms are detected at that fibre. The exact quotient modules now give short exactness of each sheaf level. Every kernel-tower transition is surjective at the fibre because each residue has a lattice representative; hence it is epic by the same exactness detection. Limit extensionality using the prescribed projections and limit-commutation equations proves the integral composite is zero. Sectionwise functorial extension of scalars and functorial sheafification prove the rational composite is zero. Apply [lem-sfb-monodromy-limit-rational-exact] to these short exact finite-level sequences and epimorphic kernel transitions.

lean.statement:
theorem sf_lattice_normalization_rational_exact (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] {T : Scheme.{u}} (p : SfMonodromyPoint T)
    (c : GaloisLisseFiniteCorrespondence p.point p.group)
    (J : SfContinuousRepresentations l E p ⥤ SfRationalModules l E T)
    {V W Z : SfContinuousRepresentations l E p} (f : V ⟶ W) (g : W ⟶ Z)
    (C : SfInvariantLattice l E V) (B : SfInvariantLattice l E W)
    (D : SfInvariantLattice l E Z)
    (hCB : ∀ a : C.submodule, f.hom.hom a.val ∈ B.submodule)
    (hBD : ∀ b : B.submodule, g.hom.hom b.val ∈ D.submodule)
    (N : SfLatticeNormalization l E p c J V C)
    (M : SfLatticeNormalization l E p c J W B)
    (P : SfLatticeNormalization l E p c J Z D)
    (F : SfNormalizationMap l E f C B hCB N M)
    (G : SfNormalizationMap l E g B D hBD M P)
    (qf : ∀ n : ℕ, sfLatticeQuotient l E C n →ₗ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E]
      sfLatticeQuotient l E B n)
    (qg : ∀ n : ℕ, sfLatticeQuotient l E B n →ₗ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E]
      sfLatticeQuotient l E D n)
    (hqf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : C.submodule), qf n (sfLatticeQuotientMk l E C n a) =
      sfLatticeQuotientMk l E B n ⟨f.hom.hom a.val, hCB a⟩)
    (hqg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : B.submodule), qg n (sfLatticeQuotientMk l E B n b) =
      sfLatticeQuotientMk l E D n ⟨g.hom.hom b.val, hBD b⟩)
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Injective (qf n) ∧ Function.Exact (qf n) (qg n) ∧
      Function.Surjective (qg n)) :
    ∃ w : SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom
        (ProEtale.lisseIntegerToFieldSized l E T) N.integral F.integral ≫
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom
        (ProEtale.lisseIntegerToFieldSized l E T) M.integral G.integral = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk
        (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom
          (ProEtale.lisseIntegerToFieldSized l E T) N.integral F.integral)
        (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom
          (ProEtale.lisseIntegerToFieldSized l E T) M.integral G.integral) w).ShortExact
